description: Read the authorized advertiser's live Google Local Services aggregate account report, including actual spend, currency and charged lead totals. Requires linked manager-account access. Dates are calendar dates inclusive at both ends. Source may lag by 30 minutes. Connected phone calls means duration over 30 seconds; responsiveness is the previous 90 days. This is not signed-case revenue or lead-rating reporting.
name: get_lsa_account_report
title: get lsa account report
